task.title: Nested dialog focus lifecycle
task.specification: config={fallback:ID,elements:{ID:{present:boolean,enabled:boolean}}}; fallback is always present/enabled and cannot be changed. Initial focus=fallback, stack=[]. element={type:'element',id,present,enabled} replaces eligibility for a nonfallback element. open={type:'open',id,opener,focus} pushes a dialog if that dialog ID is absent from stack; focus goes to its requested focus element if eligible, otherwise fallback. close/complete={type:'close'|'complete',id} closes ONLY a matching top dialog, ignoring stale/lower-layer completions. Restore its opener if eligible, otherwise the new top dialog's requested focus if eligible, otherwise fallback. After an element change, if the current focus became ineligible choose the top requested focus if eligible, otherwise fallback. Output {stack:[dialog IDs],active:top ID or null,focus:element ID,inert:[all lower dialog IDs]}. Only the active layer is interactive by this abstract contract. Eligible means present AND enabled. Return one output per event. State is opaque JSON, initially null. Output objects have exactly the documented keys; object key order is irrelevant, array order is significant. IDs are nonempty ASCII strings. Values are JSON scalars unless stated otherwise. Numeric values and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers; integral JSON notations such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same number, while booleans are distinct. Strings contain Unicode scalar values without unpaired surrogates. Inputs have at most 48 events and eight simultaneous identities. Ordinary instances vary values; boundary instances emphasize empty/disabled/equality/no-op states; adversarial instances reorder callbacks and interleave edits; shift instances use longer traces/more identities within the same rules. These tasks test controller state/effects only, not visual quality, browser integration or screen-reader usability.

matchedCard.label: Canal locks
matchedCard.relation: Passage between regions at different levels proceeds through an intermediate chamber. The chamber matches the entrance level before admission, is isolated while its level changes, and matches the departure level before release.
assumptions: The chamber can be isolated from each neighboring region.
Level differences and the states of the gates are observable.
matchedCard.boundary: Simultaneous open connections bypass the intermediate isolation. An unobserved level difference does not establish that opening a gate is appropriate.
matchedCard.source_fact: USACE describes raising and lowering vessels by closing lock gates, filling or emptying the chamber, and opening the gates after levels equalize.

shuffledCard.label: Astronomical interferometry
shuffledCard.relation: Separated measurements can be combined after their relative arrival paths are aligned. Different separations and orientations contribute different spatial information; fine detail and broad structure require complementary measurement coverage.
assumptions: The measurements concern a compatible signal and maintain the needed relative alignment.
The range of separations and orientations samples the structure being reconstructed.
shuffledCard.boundary: A longer separation does not supply missing measurement orientations or increase the collecting area by the same factor. Misaligned signals need not combine into an accurate reconstruction.
shuffledCard.source_fact: ESO describes compensating path delays in interferometry and reconstructing images from telescope baselines of different lengths and orientations, distinguishing resolution from collected light.

initial.explanation: The conditional rule is: eligibility is always present AND enabled; opening records opener and requested focus, while closing restores the recorded opener only if eligible, otherwise the new top request, otherwise fallback. Element changes repair focus only when its current target becomes ineligible. Stale or lower-layer closes do nothing.
initial.mapping: State maps element IDs to eligibility data, stores stack frames {id,opener,focus}, and stores current focus. Output derives active and inert from stack.
initial.assumptions: Each call receives the same config for the trace. Unknown nonfallback focus IDs are ineligible. Fallback remains eligible as specified.
initial.holds: function holds(input,out){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(out)||out.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,e={};for(var k in c.elements)e[k]={present:!!c.elements[k].present,enabled:!!c.elements[k].enabled};var f=c.fallback,s=[],x=f,ok=function(id){return id===f||(e[id]&&e[id].present&&e[id].enabled)},r=[];for(var z=0;z<input.events.length;z++){var v=input.events[z],i=v.id;if(v.type==='element'){e[i]={present:!!v.present,enabled:!!v.enabled};if(!ok(x)){x=s.length&&ok(s[s.length-1].focus)?s[s.length-1].focus:f}}else if(v.type==='open'){var q=0;for(var j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j].id===i)q=1;if(!q){s.push({id:i,opener:v.opener,focus:v.focus});x=ok(v.focus)?v.focus:f}}else if((v.type==='close'||v.type==='complete')&&s.length&&s[s.length-1].id===i){var w=s.pop();if(ok(w.opener))x=w.opener;else x=s.length&&ok(s[s.length-1].focus)?s[s.length-1].focus:f}var ids=s.map(function(a){return a.id}),inert=ids.slice(0,-1),got={stack:ids,active:s.length?s[s.length-1].id:null,focus:x,inert:inert};if(JSON.stringify(got)!==JSON.stringify(out[z]))return false;r.push(got)}return true}

final.explanation: Eligibility is present and enabled, except the immutable fallback, which is always eligible. The state stores current eligibility, dialog frames, and focus. Opening pushes only if the ID is absent, then focuses its requested target when eligible or the fallback. A matching top close/complete restores its opener, otherwise the new top frame’s requested target, otherwise fallback. Stale or lower-layer completions do nothing. Element changes update eligibility and repair focus only when the current focus becomes ineligible.

initial.explanation: A dialog stack stores each dialog's ID, opener, and requested focus. Eligibility is evaluated from configuration plus element-event overrides. Opening pushes only absent IDs; closing acts only on the matching top entry; element changes repair focus only when needed.
initial.mapping: Target variables are focus, stack, dialog metadata, and element eligibility. The conditional rule is: after each event, focus is the requested eligible target selected by the lifecycle precedence; otherwise use the fallback.
initial.assumptions: Configuration remains available on every call. Dialog IDs may lack element entries and are then ineligible as focus targets. State is opaque to the host but JSON-serializable.

initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state||{e:{},q:[],f:config.fallback},c=config,a=event;function ok(x){if(x===c.fallback)return true;var v=s.e[x]!==undefined?s.e[x]:c.elements[x];return !!v&&v.present&&v.enabled}if(a.type==='element'){s.e[a.id]={present:a.present,enabled:a.enabled};if(!ok(s.f))s.f=s.q.length&&ok(s.q[s.q.length-1].focus)?s.q[s.q.length-1].focus:c.fallback}else if(a.type==='open'){var z=false;for(var i=0;i<s.q.length;i++)if(s.q[i].id===a.id){z=true;break}if(!z){s.q.push({id:a.id,opener:a.opener,focus:a.focus});s.f=ok(a.focus)?a.focus:c.fallback}}else if((a.type==='close'||a.type==='complete')&&s.q.length&&s.q[s.q.length-1].id===a.id){var x=s.q.pop();if(ok(x.opener))s.f=x.opener;else s.f=s.q.length&&ok(s.q[s.q.length-1].focus)?s.q[s.q.length-1].focus:c.fallback}return{state:s,output:{stack:s.q.map(function(x){return x.id}),active:s.q.length?s.q[s.q.length-1].id:null,focus:s.f,inert:s.q.slice(0,-1).map(function(x){return x.id})}}}

final.explanation: Maintains element eligibility overrides, dialog metadata, current focus, and stack in JSON state. Opening an absent dialog pushes it and selects its requested eligible focus or fallback. Closing/completing only removes a matching top dialog, then restores its opener, the new top dialog’s requested focus, or fallback. Element updates repair focus only when the current focus becomes ineligible.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state||{e:{},q:[],f:config.fallback},a=event,c=config;function ok(id){if(id===c.fallback)return true;var v=s.e[id];if(v===undefined)v=c.elements[id];return !!v&&v.present===true&&v.enabled===true}function repair(){if(!ok(s.f))s.f=s.q.length&&ok(s.q[s.q.length-1].focus)?s.q[s.q.length-1].focus:c.fallback}if(a.type==='element'){if(a.id!==c.fallback)s.e[a.id]={present:a.present,enabled:a.enabled};repair()}else if(a.type==='open'){var exists=false,i;for(i=0;i<s.q.length;i++)if(s.q[i].id===a.id){exists=true;break}if(!exists){s.q.push({id:a.id,opener:a.opener,focus:a.focus});s.f=ok(a.focus)?a.focus:c.fallback}}else if((a.type==='close'||a.type==='complete')&&s.q.length&&s.q[s.q.length-1].id===a.id){var d=s.q.pop();if(ok(d.opener))s.f=d.opener;else if(s.q.length&&ok(s.q[s.q.length-1].focus))s.f=s.q[s.q.length-1].focus;else s.f=c.fallback}return{state:s,output:{stack:s.q.map(function(d){return d.id}),active:s.q.length?s.q[s.q.length-1].id:null,focus:s.f,inert:s.q.slice(0,-1).map(function(d){return d.id})}}}

initial.explanation: Maintain an opaque controller state containing element eligibility overrides, the ordered dialog stack, and current focus. Each event applies the specified transition, then emits a derived snapshot. Stale or lower-layer completions are ignored.
initial.mapping: Dialog stack maps to active and inert layers; each dialog record maps its ID, opener, and requested focus. Element eligibility maps to present AND enabled, with fallback always eligible.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the published identity, shape, finiteness, and trace limits. Dialog IDs are unique while present in the stack. Unknown focus IDs are ineligible unless supplied by an element configuration or later element event.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let c=input.config,s={e:{},a:[],f:c.fallback};function ok(x){if(x===c.fallback)return true;let v=s.e[x]||c.elements[x];return !!(v&&v.present&&v.enabled)}function snap(){let a=s.a;return {stack:a.map(x=>x.id),active:a.length?a[a.length-1].id:null,focus:s.f,inert:a.slice(0,-1).map(x=>x.id)}}for(let q of input.events){if(q.type==='element'){s.e[q.id]={present:q.present,enabled:q.enabled};if(!ok(s.f))s.f=s.a.length&&ok(s.a[s.a.length-1].focus)?s.a[s.a.length-1].focus:c.fallback}else if(q.type==='open'&&!s.a.some(x=>x.id===q.id)){s.a.push({id:q.id,opener:q.opener,focus:q.focus});s.f=ok(q.focus)?q.focus:c.fallback}else if((q.type==='close'||q.type==='complete')&&s.a.length&&s.a[s.a.length-1].id===q.id){let x=s.a.pop();let t=s.a.length?s.a[s.a.length-1].focus:null;s.f=ok(x.opener)?x.opener:t&&ok(t)?t:c.fallback}let z=snap(),r=output.shift();if(JSON.stringify(z)!==JSON.stringify(r))return false}return true}

final.explanation: If an element update makes the current focus ineligible, focus the active dialog’s requested focus when eligible; otherwise use the fallback. Maintain ordered dialog records, apply only valid top-layer closes/completes, and restore opener/requested focus according to eligibility.
